keep_playing_why: Game A gives me a named opponent, a lives bar and a ladder (Pip, then Barnacle), so every round has a goal and a last-pip showdown that made me want one more go. In Game B I never knew what I was winning, and most of my time went on being stuck on a verge waiting for the magnet. A's hits (CHARGED, BOTH HIT, HIGH GROUND) are small wins I can feel; B's best moments were accidental smashes.
better_made_why: A has a lot of sound work (music, thunder, lance crack, defeat sting), character intro cards, clear result banners, and a menu with a cup ladder, though the long text tips and the storm flashes hide the controls at times. B looks lovely in motion but has no music, the camera gets buried inside tree canopies and rocks, the car gets stuck at 0 mph and has to wait for a magnet, and the scoring rewards crashing over driving.
furthest_A: Squall Cup: beat Pip Tiller (cup screen showed him BEATEN), reached Bosun Barnacle (opponent 2 of 8) and kept losing to him (many defeat stings); late in the session I replayed a Pip match and was ahead 5 pips to 2 in Tilt 8 when time ran out. Never saw opponent 3.
furthest_B: Yozakura Pass, Easy: drove from 17:20 golden hour to 01:33 at night (about 40 mi on the trip counter) in one run, score about 16,270, combo never above x2, no clear end or finish seen.
